evidence: The honest conclusion is that node-property features do not reliably help the homogeneous model.
observation: TDL one-hot, novelty and ligand/PPI/GO/disease count features were standardised and added to the homogeneous GraphSAGE. TDL and novelty were negative and the count-rich variants collapsed to the base rate, so the graph's own node properties were not adopted as a prediction lever.
subject: F-65
title: Node-property features do not improve the homogeneous core model
